tree.text: The Department of Veterans Affairs is an executive department of the United States.
The purpose of the Department is to administer the laws providing benefits and other services to veterans and the dependents and the beneficiaries of veterans.
The Department is composed of the following:

children.text: Such other offices and agencies as are established or designated by law or by the President or the Secretary.
Any office, agency, or activity under the control or supervision of any element named in paragraphs (1) through (8).

Renaming of Veterans Health Services and Research AdministrationPub. L. 102–40, § 2, May 7, 1991, 105 Stat. 187, provided that: “(a) Renaming.—The establishment in the Department of Veterans Affairs known as the Veterans Health Services and Research Administration is hereby redesignated as the Veterans Health Administration. “(b) References.—Any reference to the Veterans Health Services and Research Administration (or to the Department of Medicine and Surgery of the Veterans’ Administration) in any Federal law, Executive order, regulation, delegation of authority, or document of or pertaining to the Department of Veterans Affairs shall be deemed to refer to the Veterans Health Administration.”
